legacy_corrections.text: The section title that our capture cuts off above the six list-format radios is REPORT FORMAT TO PRINT - it replaces the [?] of the inventory.

The capture is clipped at the TOP only. The hidden area holds the PRINT FORMAT section (PDF / Excel, see added_controls) and the title REPORT FORMAT TO PRINT of the list-format radios; the document names nothing else there, and the bottom of the panel (SORT BY) is complete in our capture. With PRINT FORMAT added the criteria panel is fully known.

The fifth radio is confirmed as read: Cancelled From Automated Campaigns (vendor screenshot of May 2024). In June 2023 the same radio was labelled Cancelled From Denticon Patient Engagement - an older-build label of the same option, not a further option.

Cancelled List and Missed List are history lists - they ignore whether a replacement appointment exists. Call List is the work list: with default parameters it leaves out the appointments that were replaced or taken off the call list.
DATE RANGE (Start Date / End Date) is matched on the appointment date and defaults to today - the 11/21/2026 of our capture is the capture day, not a fixed default.
CANCELLATION REASON limits the cancelled appointments to the chosen cancellation reasons - the system reasons and the ones the office defined.
Cancelled From Automated Campaigns lists the appointments that the patient cancelled through an automated campaign message.

Off call list = call-list entries that a user took off the list by ticking Off List (an entry also leaves the call list when it is rescheduled or when a new appointment is made; a removed entry can be restored). What exactly the checkbox adds to each list format is not stated beyond its name.

Length, the Status checkboxes Missed / Cancelled and Include Off Call List mirror the filters of the Scheduler's Call List screen - Select Duration (mins), Show Missed, Show Cancelled, Show Off Call List. Length is therefore an appointment-duration filter in minutes; its values other than Any are not documented (see unresolved).
Confirmation Call List is the working list for confirmation calls, for one date or a date range.
Call List is the former menu report Appointment Call List: the missed or cancelled appointments that still have no replacement.
Pull Chart List is the former menu report Appointment Pull Chart List: the "patients for the day" list used for pulling charts.
Cancelled List is the former menu report Appt Cancellation List / Appointment Cancellation List.
Missed List is the former menu report Missed Appointment List: the history of the appointments marked missed.
Vendor guides still call the Cancelled From Automated Campaigns format by its old name, Appointment Cancellation Report From Denticon Patient Communication / Engagement.

Include Patient Balance prints the patient balance on the list - shown as Curr Bal on the Cancelled List and as Bal: on the campaign-cancellation format. (Whether the checkbox is enabled for those two formats is not stated - see unresolved.)

Hidden population rule with no criteria control: a deleted appointment leaves no trace in any appointment report (it exists only in the Audit Trail) - unlike a cancelled appointment, which is removed from the schedule but kept in the appointment history and on the call list. Category-wide statement, recorded once here (Appointment List); it applies to every report of this category.

Meaning unverified: read as a layout switch that prints the patient's home office (rpt_appointment_facts.patient_home_office_id -> rpt_office_dim.office_name) beside the appointment office; the alternative reading - widen the office filter to patients whose home office is selected - must be ruled out on the live tool. Role query (adds a column).

dynamic_rules.legacy_effect: The three radios Both / Appoint Now / Appoint Now API become enabled; the User picker and both GROUP BY radios (Provider / User) are disabled.
dynamic_rules.new_behavior: only_appointnow_appointments = true enables appointnow_source (enabled_when only_appointnow_appointments == true; otherwise disabled_value both) and disables user_ids and group_by (enabled_when only_appointnow_appointments == false; disabled values all and provider). The printed title becomes Appointment Detail (For Only AppointNow Appointments) through title_templates, and the main block groups Office -> User Appoint Now -> Provider -> day band as in the legacy sample. The AppointNow block takes its level list from only_appointnow_appointments, never from group_by: it ignores the (disabled) group_by value.

legacy_corrections.text: The row that the action bar cuts off is the third and last row of OTHER OPTIONS, Include Patient Home Office (see added_controls); nothing follows it, so with that control the criteria panel is complete.
The placeholder control [?] (clipped third row of OTHER OPTIONS) is the checkbox Include Patient Home Office recorded under added_controls - one control, not two.
Only AppointNow Appointments restricts the report to online (AppointNow) bookings.
Appoint Now API selects the bookings made by third parties through the AppointNow API.
User refers to the user who created the appointment: the vendor uses the report to review the appointments created by a user.
The radio chooses the date basis of the range: the date of the appointment (Appointment Date) or the date the appointment was created (Created On Date).
Without the tick the report lists the non-cancelled appointments only - missed ones are included; Include Cancelled Appointments adds the cancelled ones.
GROUP BY sets the first grouping level under the office: Provider or User.

The pre-2021 menu reports Appointment Details Report and Appointment Detail By User are this report; the by-user one corresponds to GROUP BY = User (a restricted variant, Appointment Detail by User, also lives in My Reports).
Created dates are stored in Pacific (server) time with no office-local conversion, so DATE RANGE = Created On Date is matched on the Pacific-time creation date.
Include Patient Phone Number adds the patient phone numbers to the listing.
Hidden population rule with no criteria control: deleted appointments never appear on this report (stated by the document for every appointment report - see Appointment List).

actions.new_feature: Clear criteria: resets every parameter of the report to its default value.
Run: preview on screen, then print or export in the chosen output format.
Add to favorites: saves the report with the current criteria as a favorite (saved view).

controls.notes: Legacy title REPORT TYPE, but the radio is the date basis of the APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE below it (vendor documentation; the section keeps its title whichever option is chosen). Sent Date / Due Date / Received Date -> rpt_lab_cases.lab_sent_on / lab_due_on / lab_received_on. All -> appointment_date is unverified (04 7.3, to confirm): the alternative reading - the range matches any of the four dates - must be checked on the live tool. The vendor recommends Received Date for the monthly lab cost run. Same choice as date_basis of the existing lab cost report endpoint (appointment / sent / due / received). If the live tool shows the any-of-four reading, the option value any_lab_date (NEW, owner 04 7.3) is reserved for it.
PRINT / PREVIEW always previews on screen first. Enhanced with csv. Excel is a flat typed sheet, not the legacy merged layout.
Office versus Office Group. Both options enabled on this report (nothing greyed in the capture); applied to the appointment office (rule d03).

108 = id of the office the user was working in. Offices (mode office) or office groups (mode office_group). Vendor documentation: Office = one or more offices the user can access (default the logged-in office); Office Group = groups from Setup > Office Groups (default ALL). The selection becomes exactly one of the value keys office_ids / office_group_id / office_group_ids; tokens working_office, my_offices; all = every office (or group) the caller may read. Filters the appointment office (rpt_appointment_facts.office_id; rpt_lab_cases.office_id on the lab reports).

Legacy SELECT dialog (dual list with INCLUDE ALL, search, sort) becomes a searchable multi-select; ALL = no restriction. Dialog content was never captured - confirm list source and inactive rows on the live tool. Provider role (line, appointment, preferred) is declared per report. Role appointment on this report: the appointment provider; roster-first list, never scoped by providers.office_id.

Legacy SELECT dialog (dual list with INCLUDE ALL, search, sort) becomes a searchable multi-select; ALL = no restriction. Dialog content was never captured - confirm list source and inactive rows on the live tool.

Basis chosen by REPORT TYPE (date_basis): appointment_date, lab_sent_on, lab_due_on or lab_received_on of rpt_lab_cases; the section keeps its legacy title APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE whatever the basis. Default = today in the office time zone (relative token). Enhanced with presets and relative tokens.
Inclusive end; basis chosen by REPORT TYPE (date_basis). Default = today in the office time zone (relative token). Enhanced with presets and relative tokens.

Exclude filter: None = exclude nothing; rows whose value is in the list are dropped. Dialog content was never captured - confirm on the live tool. Patients without a type are kept; no_type_defined drops them.
Exclude filter: None = exclude nothing; rows whose value is in the list are dropped. Dialog content was never captured - confirm on the live tool.

legacy_corrections.text: REPORT TYPE chooses which date the range is matched against (Sent Date, Due Date or Received Date); the date section keeps the title APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE whichever is chosen. The vendor recommends Received Date. What All matches is unverified (see unresolved).

Hidden population rule with no criteria control: the lab reports read the lab fields stored on the appointment (Lab, Lab Cost, Sent on, Due on, Recvd. on); a case that is not recorded in those fields never appears on the report.
